→ Check it against C3: `ls hook/.claude/telemetry_tool/` gives the same list in seconds — keep only the non-obvious part (which script runs on which hook event).

svg.text: Yield — reads after which the same agent opened a code path first seen in that read / reads that showed a new path (Q1). Upkeep reads excluded.
Expl. after — agents · searches in the article's area after reading it, ≥ 2 searches (Q4, Q5). Route miss — agents that searched the area ≥ 3× without opening it / all such agents (Q8).
Area — back-ticked code files of the article (server/ client/ hook/ scripts/ packages/ tests/), folders dropped, paths shared by > 3 articles dropped (Q6). Catalog — area > 30 files.
Dead — path shown as new in ≥ 4 reads, never followed (Q11). Upkeep — reads by an agent that also edits the article (FR-5). § — Read offset/limit or sed -n (FR-4).
Click a row for the drill-down (real-2 / real-3).
